Fused belief about the car being advised.

Energy is nullable: a public-only source cannot observe battery state, and
a missing value must gate precise energy advice rather than be invented.

The published, lifecycle-managed instruction shown to the engineer.

RivalBelief.description:
Belief about one rival, built only from permitted observations.

Rival energy is never ``measured``: without an authorised feed it is an
estimate with a wide interval, and it may be entirely unknown.

gap_s.description: Signed time gap at common progress; positive is ahead.

lateral_geometry_known.description: False when the source cannot resolve lateral placement; blocks contact-risk claims.

TelemetrySeries.description:
A downsampled numeric trace for display.

``sample_count`` is the original resolution; downsampling must preserve
extrema and event crossings, and exact inspection uses the raw arrays held
server-side.

TelemetryChunkManifest.description:
Immutable descriptor of a completed Parquet chunk.

Readers consume only chunks that appear here, which is what makes the
staging-then-manifest write atomic from a reader's point of view.
TelemetryChunkManifest.title: TelemetryChunkManifest

TelemetryEvent.description:
One canonical channel sample after normalisation.

Field order and constraints mirror the normative JSON schema. ``value`` may
be ``None`` for an explicitly missing sample; ``quality`` must then say so.
